newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Telecom unveils details of merger with ITJ.
newsitem.headline: Japan Telecom unveils details of merger with ITJ.

text.p: Japan Telecom Co Ltd announced on Thursday that it had formally applied to the Posts Ministry to proceed with its planned merger with International Telecom Japan (ITJ) on October 1, under which 12 ITJ shares will be swapped for one Japan Telecom share.
Japan Telecom is a domestic long-distance carrier and ITJ is one of Japan's international telecommunications companies.
Japan Telecom said in a statement that a new company to be created on the merger will be capitalised at 67.0 billion yen.
The new company will take the name of Japan Telecom and ITJ will be dissolved on the merger, it said.
Japan Telecom said the merger was aimed at boosting the competitiveness of the companies in the fast-growing global telecoms market by improving services and strengthening their business foundations.
